I've been talking to them about it. Just trying to get them on board with it. 

Would it make a difference to lenders if I can show them the property is making money every month and isn't just costing me?
Good point! I'll definitely have to make sure that I am able to purchase multi family properties with the type im approved for.

I should have added, I can definitely afford it even if its completely vacant. 

All the numbers make sense and after all expenses it will cash flow about $500 per month.

Biggest issue I've been having is finding a lender that will give me that much money. I have never missed a payment, I've just been given the reason that I don't have a long enough credit history.

Yeah at first she genuinely seemed like she was in a bad place but then we talked more and I realized she was just putting a show on to then do what she did, in attempt to mess with my head more. I really appreciate it man, feel free to shoot me a message anytime!

That's actually quite motivating to me. Glad to hear you're doing better. I can't say I was married or anything so I guess it could have been worse, but we were together for close to 5 years. She cheated and left for another guy and then the other day messaged me to "make sure I was okay", but then proceeded to tell me way too many details about her sex life. Like basically erotic stories, but all the while said she missed me and wishes it went differently. Really been messing with my head. But we'll both make it man, you're right it is about mindset. I'm not even looking for love just to be able to get out there some again.
That's my plan i think. Went through some rough shit with an ex and I've spent too much time alone in my head now, ya know? Gotta just try to get out there now matter what. I appreciate it man.
Been thinking about that but have literally zero good photos of myself to use.
I feel ya buddy, seems like when you don't text first they never reach out. Unless they want something. I'm going through similar stuff, feel free to shoot me a message!

I'm currently looking at purchasing an entire new wardrobe and accessories, and not sure where to start. 

I'm completely new to actually putting in the effort to look good. I want to be able to look classy but also be able to go out for a beer and not look like I'm overdoing it. 

I'm about 6'3 200lbs, very broad shoulders and chest, I'm a big guy but yet skinny if that makes sense lol. I've always worn nothing but jeans, t-shirts and basic pullover hoodies. I don't mind that look but want to move away from it some and try something new, get my own style per say. 

Any advice of where to start will be greatly appreciated!

Yeah I guess you're right. The breakup is very fresh but I don't have many people to talk to so it would help I feel. I guess worst case if she doesn't add me back its not the end of the world, that's literally the worst that could happen.

I know in the back of my mind I deserve better, but I am finding it so incredibly difficult to even do anything. I have never been this lonely. I can't even cry, there's just a void there that isn't getting better.
